decisions.reason: Core transactional email service is prominently featured on the home page and central to the firm's cloud messaging offer.
Document capture and recognition aligns with the firm's shift toward electronic document workflows and has a dedicated webpage.
Email-to-fax conversion remains relevant for regulated German business communications even if only briefly mentioned on the website.
Fax delivery optimization is a complementary feature close to existing fax services and likely supports customer retention.
Email sandbox threat protection addresses growing security needs and fits the firm's managed communication portfolio.
Multi-engine virus scanning enhances email security and, while only mentioned, is a low-cost extension of existing services.
